    <p>The SAP series of PM high-speed steel serves the high-end tool &amp; die industry as an import substitute. A novel powder-metallurgy process needs only minimal machining to deliver tool/die parts in any shape and size. Beyond PM-HSS, the SAP tool/die material family also covers die steel, high-chromium stainless HSS, high-vanadium HSS, Ti-Ni HSS, TiC/TiCN steel-bonded carbides, and Fe-Cr / Fe-Mn / Ni-Cr steel-bonded carbides.</p>
    <h2>Specifications</h2>
      <ul class="specs">
      <li>Near-net-shape complex parts with shape customization, cutting user machining cost</li>
      <li>Low impurity content (O≤60ppm, S≤80ppm, P≤50ppm)</li>
      <li>Breaks the alloying limits of conventional melting; easy composition adjustment</li>
      <li>Strong at ultra-hard phase-reinforced PM high-speed steel</li>
